name: strongman keg toss
description: An explosive strongman lift where you heave a heavy keg up and over a bar behind you. It builds hip power and total body drive.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and the keg between your legs, gripping it low with both hands.
Hinge at the hips, keep your chest up and your back flat.
Drive your hips forward hard and pull the keg up your body.
Extend fully and throw the keg up and back over the bar.
Reset, step back to the start and repeat with control.
